question: In which of the following years was the final Constitution adopted in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1949.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The** Indian Constitution** was** passed and adopted **by the assembly on **November 26, 1949.**
 
• The Constitution had **395 articles and 8 schedules **when it was adopted, and it was nearly **145,000 words long**, making it the** longest national constitution ever.**
